name: Warp Text
description: WebGL text that continuously ripples and refracts, with a lens that follows the pointer, click shockwaves, optional chromatic split and an animated intro reveal.
contents: Single block of multi-line text rendered to a canvas texture and drawn by a shader
Accessible role img wrapper with aria-label and a plain text fallback if WebGL fails
behavior: Ambient noise warp drifts the text constantly
Pointer lens distorts text near the cursor, and idles in a gentle drift path when the pointer is away
Optional ripple rings around the pointer and click shockwaves (up to 4 at once)
Intro animation settles from a strong blur-warp into the final text
Pauses rendering when offscreen or tab hidden, honors prefers-reduced-motion by freezing time and reducing effects
Text auto-shrinks to fit 86% width and 78% height of the container, and re-rasterizes on resize and color change
editableByProps: Text content (use newlines for multiple lines), color, font size, weight, family, letter spacing and line height
Warp strength, scale and speed, refraction, chromatic split, idle drift
Pointer lens size, strength and style, ripple rings, click ripples, intro on or off
Container size and extra styling through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Add a new lens distortion style
needsCodeEdit.where: LENS_MODES constant and the uLens branch in the fragment shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Change intro duration or click ripple lifetime and count
Change minimum height of the effect
needsCodeEdit.where: min-h-[220px] class on the root div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how much of the container the text may fill

fixed: Requires the ogl package and a WebGL2 browser, otherwise a plain text fallback is shown
Text is drawn on a canvas, so it is not selectable and only the aria-label exposes it
Size comes from the container: root is w-full with a 220px minimum height, so give it a height through className or a parent
Root clips overflow and inherits border radius
Pointer lens is ignored for touch input, touch devices only see ambient warp and click ripples
Text is set as a prop so changing color via CSS is detected by polling about every 15 frames
Works on small screens because the font size is fluid and the text auto-fits

options.look: Text swells outward around the pointer like a magnifying lens
options.useWhen: Hero headline that should feel like it reacts and magnifies under the cursor

options.look: Text is pulled inward toward the pointer
options.useWhen: Dark or moody landing section where the headline should feel sucked into the cursor

options.look: Text twists in a vortex around the pointer
options.useWhen: Playful event or music page headline that should feel energetic and spinning
